name: Mozilla
body: The home page lists 85 hreflang alternates, HSTS is on, and framing is denied. But robots.txt names no sitemap and /sitemap.xml answers 404, so crawlers find pages only by following links.
lesson: Publish a sitemap.xml of the pages you want found and name it in robots.txt with one Sitemap: line.
summary: www.mozilla.org scores 86 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 15 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: 15 images have no alt attribute.

fix.title: 15 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 10 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /en-US/products/monitor/, /en-US/contribute/, /en-US/advertising/, /en-US/about/leadership/ and 6 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: 1 page asks search engines not to index it
fix.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should be found, and keep it only on private or duplicate pages.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 9 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 623 ms
Language alternates point at each other
